description: Send keystrokes to the peer. In `combo` mode (default), `keys` is one or more key combos separated by whitespace, e.g. "ctrl+alt+t" or "ctrl+s ctrl+w". In `type` mode, `keys` is literal text. In `down`/`up` mode, hold or release a single key combo. Requires an active viewer session.

keys.description: Either key-combo string(s) (`ctrl+alt+Delete`) or, in type mode, the literal text to type.

mode.description: How to interpret `keys`. `combo` = key combos / shortcuts. `type` = literal text. `down`/`up` = hold or release one combo.

name: jrd_keyboard
